response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong web/backend depth, low-latency systems work in D at Sociomantic, and genuine community leadership (workshops, courses, open-source tooling). However, the role's hard requirement of 8 years of C++ is not close to being met — the resume shows roughly six months of C/C++ at National Instruments plus a university thesis project. Similarly, there is little evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform ownership, hardware/storage architecture, or a formal technical-leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The profile is a strong full-stack/product engineer rather than a systems-level C++ platform lead, so this is a poor match for the stated minimum qualifications.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency distributed services (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing: workshops, Selenium course, dojos, conference talks
Broad polyglot engineering with strong testing/TDD, CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes exposure
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ versus the 8-year minimum requirement
No production cloud compute platform architecture or hardware/storage systems experience
No formal technical-leadership role owning strategy, priorities, and cross-team alignment

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform / infrastructure ownership
Distributed systems and mentoring track record
